text_block_list.text: It happened when I was passing near the fields—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Mmm,
you have a wonderful, healthy glow!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Graceful! The tension on your surface is marvelous.
It shows just how well-nurtured you are!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
“—Mm?! What a coincidence!
Well met, welcome, Trainer!”
choice_data_list: Um, what are you doing here...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to explain! I was simply praising
the honorable carrots gathered here.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Craving! I wish to provide the Umamusume with a wonderful environment.
In other words, high-quality carrots are essential!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Carrots that are highly nutritious and delicious—
in other words, carrots grown with love!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Fact! If praised with love,
carrots grow splendidly. Just like Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Love is respect and resolve!
Knowing the true essence of your subject, and treating it with reverence."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
To see things through to the very end, no matter what happens.
To praise them, nurture them, and bring out their utmost potential.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "That is what love is! In other words—"

Just as Chairwoman Akikawa crouched down
and pulled out a single carrot—
(Crunch!!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Like this!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, delicious! This flavor is true proof of growth.
Taking the responsibility to raise it was well worth it!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Craving! I truly hope the Umamusume will
one day mature just like these fine carrots!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever it takes.
Until the day comes... that everyone reaches maturity!

Chairwoman Akikawa speaks with passionate fervor.
Though I can't quite grasp what she's getting at...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Encouragement! Grow even more, everyone!
Grow strong and sturdy enough to reach the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
So that you may one day become fine nourishment for our Umamusume!
Now is the time to grow, my fellow carrots!

You could feel that in her own way, she was
facing the Umamusume with utmost sincerity.

What is more, I believe there is something respectable
in her ambition. In that case—
choice_data_list: Shall I help with the fieldwork?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astonishing!
Truly a bolt from the blue...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Request!
If you don't mind, I would love your help!
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll go till the field.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Much appreciated! For the sake of both the Umamusume
and the carrots, give it your absolute all!

Perhaps it's thanks to all the special training with <chrname>.
Power kept welling up, and I plowed the field in no time!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In top form! Oh yeah, mm-mmh!
Do that spot too while you're at it! And over here please!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Having tilled this much soil,
we shall soon be able to sow new seeds.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Splendid work! I must reward you for such efforts!
choice_data_list: In that case, could I get some new training equipment?
In that case, could I have some carrots?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged! In that case,
allow me to present this to you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The latest training shoes
based on Umamusume engineeringâ

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I name them... Tracen Academy Model Horseshoe Shoes!
From planning to supervision, I was involved the whole way!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Good growth requires good tools!
I only did what was natural!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"These shoes too shall serve as a 'carrot'
to nurture all of our Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: High hopes! Continue to nurture and raise your Umamusume with love and care!

Chairwoman Akikawa's passion comes through loud and clear.
I'll go hand these shoes over to <chrname> right away.
Acquired "<itemname>".

From its structure to every tiny detail, the shoes
were overflowing with Chairwoman Akikawa's love for Umamusume—

Encouraged by the occasional "Keep it up!" sound effect whenever she stepped down on her heels,
she put even more vigor into her training!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged! Then let us praise and extol
our dear carrots together!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You there! What an imposing, magnificent build!
You're as sturdy as a mighty oak!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Craving! Please, you must speak words of encouragement
to our dear carrots as well!
choice_data_list: Your color is so deep! You look full of nutrients!
Your color is so rich! You look packed with nutrients!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, truly splendid...!
What absolutely wonderful praise!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, truly SPLENDID! As expected of Tracen Academy!
The trainers here are of the highest caliber!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Confirmed! The carrots
must have become even more delicious!
Acquired "<itemname>".

A few days later, Chairwoman Akikawa sent over
a massive shipment of carrots, so—

I rounded up <chrname> and some passing
friends, and we threw a massive carrot party!

After thoroughly enjoying some delicious carrots,
<chrname> was able to tackle her training with full energy!
